_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mgr-tenants container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mgr-tenants container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mgr-tenants container in MiB

deployment.description: mgr-tenants keeps no local state: tenant data lives in PostgreSQL and realm data in Keycloak, and Liquibase migrations are guarded by the database changelog lock. Multiple replicas can run behind a load balancer; two are recommended for availability, as tenant provisioning is low-volume.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mgr-tenants schema

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used by the Kafka admin client to delete tenant topics when a tenant is deleted with purgeKafkaTopics=true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix when tenant topics are deleted; must match the value used by the other modules sharing the Kafka cluster. Falls back to 'folio' when unset

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on

EnvVars.name: MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_HEADER_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request header; raised above the server default to accommodate large JWTs

EnvVars.name: ROUTER_PATH_PREFIX
EnvVars.description: Prefix added to every endpoint path exposed by the module (/tenants becomes {prefix}/tenants). Set it when the load-balancer group has the form {host}/{moduleId}

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mgr-tenants process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SECURITY_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables request authentication and authorization. With KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true, Keycloak acts as the security provider

EnvVars.name: MTE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenant-entitlements. Queried before tenant deletion; deletion is blocked when the service is unreachable or reports active entitlements

EnvVars.name: CACHE_EXPIRATION_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time-to-live of the cached Keycloak access token used for realm operations

EnvVars.name: APIGW_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables API gateway integration. When false, all gateway-related beans are excluded and the module does not self-register

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TYPE
EnvVars.description: API gateway implementation used for self-registration: kong or apisix

EnvVars.name: APIGW_URL
EnvVars.description: Admin URL of the API gateway. For apisix, the Admin API origin without the /apisix/admin path

EnvVars.name: APIGW_API_KEY
EnvVars.description: APISIX Admin API key sent as X-API-KEY. Required when APIGW_TYPE=apisix, ignored for kong

EnvVars.name: APIGW_REGISTER_MODULE
EnvVars.description: Defines whether the module self-registers its routes in the API gateway at startup

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: URL at which the API gateway reaches this module; used as the upstream when the module self-registers

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding the Keycloak admin client secret and the per-tenant client secrets. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables Keycloak integration: realm and client management for tenants and Keycloak-based security. When false, all Keycloak-related beans are excluded

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of Keycloak, used for realm administration and token requests

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_BASE_URL
EnvVars.description: Override base URL for JWKS retrieval. When empty, the issuer URL from the token iss claim is used. Set it to reach Keycloak through an internal address instead of the public one

EnvVars.name: KC_IMPORT_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: At startup, creates or updates the module's own records in Keycloak (resource server, client, resources, permissions, roles, policies) from its internal module descriptor

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin client used for realm and client management. Its secret is read from the secure store, not from an environment variable

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_GRANT_TYPE
EnvVars.description: OAuth2 grant type used to obtain the Keycloak admin token

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Connect timeout of the Keycloak admin client (Spring Duration syntax, e.g. 10s, 500ms)

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Read timeout of the Keycloak admin client (Spring Duration syntax, e.g. 60s, 2m)

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client ID under which the module registers itself in Keycloak when KC_IMPORT_ENABLED=true

EnvVars.name: KC_SERVICE_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client ID created in every tenant realm for module-to-module requests

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix appended to the tenant name to derive the login client ID created in each tenant realm (e.g. diku-application). Must match the value used by the module sidecars

EnvVars.name: KC_IMPERSONATION_CLIENT
EnvVars.description: Client ID created in every tenant realm with permission to impersonate users

EnvVars.name: KC_PASSWORD_RESET_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client ID created in every tenant realm for password reset operations

EnvVars.name: KC_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TTL
EnvVars.description: Lifespan of the password reset token in seconds (1 day by default, 4 weeks maximum)

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_SECRET_LENGTH
EnvVars.description: Length of the client secrets generated for the clients created in tenant realms

EnvVars.name: KC_ACCESS_CODE_TTL
EnvVars.description: Lifespan in seconds of the authorization access code configured on tenant realms

EnvVars.name: KC_PAR_REQUEST_URI_TTL
EnvVars.description: Lifespan in seconds of the pushed authorization request (PAR) URI configured on tenant realms

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTH_TOKEN_VALIDATE_URI
EnvVars.description: When true, validates that the Keycloak URL matches the issuer of the incoming JWT

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in seconds between scheduled JWKS cache refreshes for the realm JWT parser

EnvVars.name: KC_FORCED_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in seconds for forced JWKS refreshes of the realm JWT parser; applies to signing key rotation
